content.value_statement: Skill authors often need a repeatable process for turning ad hoc workflows into reusable AI instructions. This skill guides discovery, resource planning, editing, packaging, and iteration.
actual_capabilities: Explains the required SKILL.md file and optional resource directories.
Guides authors through concrete examples before writing a skill.
Helps decide when to add scripts, references, and assets.
Describes how to initialize a new skill with a helper script.
Covers editing, packaging, validation, and iteration workflows.
limitations: It provides guidance only and does not include the helper scripts it references.
It does not validate a finished skill by itself.
The source wording focuses on Claude, although the workflow is broadly useful.
It depends on users providing examples and domain materials for each skill.

use_cases.title: Create a New Team Skill
use_cases.description: Turn a repeated team workflow into a structured skill with clear instructions and reusable resources.

use_cases.title: Improve an Existing Skill
use_cases.description: Review a current SKILL.md and identify missing examples, references, scripts, or packaging steps.

use_cases.title: Package Skills for Distribution
use_cases.description: Prepare a skill for sharing by checking metadata, resource organization, validation, and iteration steps.

prompt_templates.title: Define a Skill Idea
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner prompt for starting from a rough workflow.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a skill for [workflow]. Ask for the minimum examples you need, then propose the SKILL.md outline and useful resources.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Skill Resources
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate prompt for choosing scripts, references, and assets.
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze these examples for a skill: [examples]. Recommend which instructions belong in SKILL.md and which resources should be bundled.

prompt_templates.title: Revise an Existing Skill
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate prompt for improving a draft skill.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this skill draft for clarity, trigger quality, resource organization, and missing validation steps. Suggest focused improvements.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare for Marketplace Review
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced prompt for final packaging and publication readiness.
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this skill package for metadata quality, resource references, packaging readiness, and user-facing limitations before publication.

output_examples.input: A user wants a skill for recurring PDF rotation and splitting tasks.
output_examples.output: The skill recommends a focused SKILL.md, a deterministic PDF script, usage examples, validation notes, and packaging steps.

output_examples.input: A team has database support questions that require the same schema context each time.
output_examples.output: The skill proposes a concise workflow, a schema reference file, example user requests, and guidance for loading references only when needed.

output_examples.input: A draft skill has long instructions and duplicated reference material.
output_examples.output: The skill suggests moving detailed reference content into separate files and keeping SKILL.md focused on core workflow steps.

best_practices: Start with concrete user examples before designing the skill structure.
Keep SKILL.md focused and move detailed reference material into bundled resources.
Package and validate the skill before sharing it with other users.
anti_patterns: Do not create broad skills without clear trigger examples.
Do not duplicate the same large reference text in SKILL.md and reference files.
Do not keep generated example resources that are unrelated to the final skill.

faq.question: What does this skill help me create?
faq.answer: It helps create or improve AI skills that package workflows, instructions, references, scripts, and assets.

faq.question: Does it generate a complete skill automatically?
faq.answer: No. It guides the process and references helper scripts, but users still provide examples and content.

faq.question: Can I use it with Claude Code or Codex?
faq.answer: Yes. The workflow is useful for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code skill authoring.

faq.question: When should I add scripts to a skill?
faq.answer: Add scripts when a task needs deterministic behavior or repeated code would otherwise be rewritten often.

faq.question: When should I use reference files?
faq.answer: Use reference files for detailed schemas, policies, API docs, and domain material loaded only when needed.

faq.question: What should I check before sharing a skill?
faq.answer: Check metadata, file organization, resource references, validation results, and whether example files are still needed.
